title: Nkwa nke Nwa A Na-amụbeghị
intro: Mkpụrụ obi nwere ezi obi kwere nkwa dị nsọ tupu nwatakịrị abịa. Akụkọ onye a na-apụta ìhè n'ime mgbidi nke ebe nsọ, ebe ofufe na-ezute nnabata Chineke. Ònye bụ ohu Allah a?
clues: E si n'ezinụlọ a na-asọpụrụ n'ime Quran.
Ekwere m nkwa siri ike na m ga-arara nwa m a na-amụbeghị nye maka ijere Allah ozi.
Mgbe m mụrụ nwa, o juru m anya na ọ bụ ada, mana m tụrụ anya na ọ ga-amụ nwa nwoke.
Aha m kpọrọ nwa m Meri, aha na-egosi nraranye na ọrụ.
Arịọrọ m nchebe Chineke maka nwa m na ụmụ ya n'aka Setan a bụrụ ọnụ.
Onyenweanyị nabatara nwa m ma tinye ya n'okpuru onye amụma Zakariya n'ụlọ nsọ.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Na-ekwe nkwa ịrara nwa ya nye n'ụlọ nsọ
trial.answer: Na-ekwe nkwa ịrara nwa ya nye n'ụlọ nsọ

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Ebe nsọ (mihrab) ebe e tinyere nwa ya
Nkwụ date ahụ o zuru ike n'okpuru ya
location.answer: Ebe nsọ (mihrab) ebe e tinyere nwa ya

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A nabatara nwa ya ma tinye ya n'okpuru nlekọta onye amụma Zakariya.
A zọpụtara ya n'aka onye ọchịchị aka ike
A mụrụ ya nwa nwoke aha ya bụ Yahya
Ọ ghọrọ eze nwanyị n'alaeze ukwu
outcome.answer: A nabatara nwa ya ma tinye ya n'okpuru nlekọta onye amụma Zakariya.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
